stable_finding: audio.cpp is a source-level second native C++/ggml/GGUF speech-runtime challenger because its released surface includes German Qwen3-ASR plus multiple German-capable TTS/VAD candidates in one framework. Source breadth does not prove shared model memory, lower concurrent residency, lower p95/p99 or German quality.
critical_gap: Qwen3-TTS is not marked Stream in the v0.7.0 support table, so a complete low-latency Qwen3-ASR + Qwen3-TTS Frankenstein path is not source-proven.
counterhypothesis: Model-specific NeMo-Speech.cpp/CrispASR/reference paths remain superior; audio.cpp may add integration breadth without target latency/residency advantage or may still require a mixed runtime because of streaming gaps.
next_discriminator: Only after a real clay-direct-dev hardware/resource receipt: compare pinned audio.cpp v0.7.0 against pinned NeMo-Speech.cpp/CrispASR/reference paths under equivalent model identities and German fixtures; measure combined RSS/VRAM, p50/p95/p99, ASR/TTS concurrency, German quality, cancellation correctness and network-blocked operation.
